company.name: TOTL - Cashback, eVoucher, Payments & Discounts
company.description:
TOTL brings a unique platform that unbolts the world of Instant Payments with Instant Rewards to the UAE consumers. Partnered with over 600+ local offline businesses across the UAE, TOTL brings value for every spend by offering consumers Instant Cashback on Payments, eVouchers and eGifts with added value that encourages brand affinity and loyalty with the joy of getting back on their daily spends.
Pay via App, QR codes, Purchase eVoucher or gift eGifts to friends and family with an ability to get back or save on every spend with TOTL’s smart, secure and simple ways to interact with businesses in the UAE.
TOTL is committed to work with the local business community who strive to build loyalty and bring back the customers for a superlative customer experience each time they visit their business. 
Transforming Payments & Loyalty Culture bringing together Savings Community in UAE.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Pre Seed round raised $1,500,000, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $10,935,178 to $10,935,178, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 69 (-2 over 90 days) and market heat at 65 (-19).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set

insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
